oil_life_monitor: The Oil Control System (OCS) calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Under light conditions (freeway/city driving, no towing, no extended idling) the display timing is Normal. Under extreme conditions (repeated short trips under 5 miles, short trips under 10 miles in freezing temps, hot-weather stop-and-go traffic, extensive idling/low-speed driving, car-top carrier use, frequent braking/mountainous driving, sustained high-speed driving) the display timing is Early. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change oil within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). If the OCS resets prematurely or becomes inoperative, change oil within 6 months or 5,000 miles (8,000 km) from last oil change.
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
Towing a trailer, using a camper or using a car-top carrier
extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule is presented as milestone-by-milestone entries (every 5,000 miles up to 120,000 miles) rather than a simple interval table; intervals were reconstructed by identifying the repeating pattern across milestones.
2. Engine oil & filter: The standard schedule shows replacement at every 10,000-mile/12-month interval (5,000-mile entries say 'Not applicable' for standard; oil changes appear at 10k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k miles). The OCS may shorten this interval under severe conditions.
3. In-cabin microfilter and Intelligent Key battery: Appear at 15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k miles = every 15,000 miles/18 months.
4. Air cleaner filter: Appears at 30k, 60k, 90k miles = every 30,000 miles/36 months.
5. Brake fluid: In standard schedule, replace appears at 10k, 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k (every 20k starting from 10k). In severe schedule, replace appears at every 10k interval. Recorded as 'both' schedule with 10k interval since severe calls for it every 10k.
6. Engine drive belts (*): First appears at 40k miles, then 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k = every 10,000 miles/12 months starting at 40k. Marked as *-item (recommended, not required for emission warranty).
7. Automatic transmission fluid: Only one replacement shown in the provided pages, at 90,000 miles/108 months. No subsequent interval is explicitly stated in the provided text.
8. Engine coolant (*): First replacement at 105,000 miles or 84 months; thereafter every 75,000 miles/60 months per footnote on page 609. Marked as *-item.
9. Spark plugs: Replacement shown at 105,000 miles only; no month interval stated in the schedule entry itself (only miles shown in the 105k milestone).
10. Engine valve clearance (*): No mileage/time interval given; inspect only if valve noise increases.
11. Differential gear oil, transfer fluid, coupling oil (4WD): Standard schedule shows inspection every 10,000 miles (appears at 10k, 20k, 30k, etc.); severe use schedule shows replacement every 20,000 miles (at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k milestones).
12. Fuel tank vapor vent system and fuel lines/connections are *-items appearing at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k miles in standard schedule = every 20,000 miles/24 months.
13. Propeller shaft inspection (4WD) appears at every 10,000-mile standard interval alongside brake pads/rotors.
14. No transfer fluid or coupling oil fluid specifications (viscosity/grade) were provided in the pages supplied.
15. Engine coolant capacity: both 'with tow package' (11.9 L / 3-1/8 gal) and 'without tow package' (11.6 L / 3-1/8 gal) round to the same US gallon figure in the table.
16. Exhaust system inspection: In standard schedule, appears at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k (every 20k). In severe schedule appears at every 5k/10k. Recorded as standard at 20k interval.
17. Steering gear & linkage and Axle & suspension parts: In standard schedule, appear at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k (every 20k). In severe schedule appear at every 5k/10k.
18. Brake lines and cables: In standard schedule, appear at 10k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k (every 10k).
